reason: Fresh audit of the Cesaro proof and its actual suppliers: the indicator of the fixed target state is pi-integrable, so the AC-qualified chain ergodic theorem yields the pathwise occupation-frequency limit from the deterministic start; the bounded averages then pass to expectations by finite-measure bounded convergence; Chapman–Kolmogorov at m=0 and the transition-matrix definition identify each expected indicator with p^(k)(x,y), and finite-sum linearity gives the asserted Cesaro limit. I re-read the current ergodic theorem and its Kac, iid return-excursion, recurrence-class, iid strong-law, and monotone-convergence suppliers, plus the bounded-convergence and chain Chapman–Kolmogorov sources. The time-zero term is included and no aperiodicity is used. No consumer-file change was needed.
